topic: Why did Mahavira endure a 12-year fast — and why did he break it with kheer in a merchant's house? (source: Kalpasutra)
title: Mahavira ne 12 saal bhookha reh kar kheer kyun khayi?
review: 19 Nov source check: false story. Mahavira did NOT go 12 years without food or water: he broke fasts on about 325 of 4545 days (fasts of 2 days to 6 months); kevalgyan came during a 2-day fast under a sal tree by the Rijuvalika at Jrimbhikagram, not after a meal of kheer from a seth (source: Kishor B Shah, Oshwal UK, from Kalpasutra / Trishashti-shalaka-purusha-charitra)

19 Nov audit: story check needed: Mahavira's famous first meal after the long fast is Chandanbala offering urad (bakula); 'a seth brought kheer' must be confirmed in Kalpasutra / Trishashti-shalaka before posting
